*Monthly Options:

Resident Options:*

Monthly Standard:
24/7 monthly municipal garage parking.
Monthly Limited:*
Discounted rate for someone who drives to work. Parking hours are: 4:00pm-10:00am You may not park during the hours of: 10:00am-4:00pm.
*Customers are entitled to two (2) rollover days for a maximum of 24 days. These days don't renew yearly. There will be a twenty dollar ($20.00) fee charged for every day the vehicle is parked between 10:00am-4:00pm weekdays once the maximum days have been reached.
Monthly Reserved:
Monthly reserved space in a municipal garage.
Vacation Spot:
Planning time away from Hoboken and usually park on-street? To avoid street cleaning tickets or the hassle of asking friends/family members to move cars, limited discounted parking is available to residents in Garage D at 215 Hudson Street for up to 14 days per year. The fee is $6/day, with a maximum of 14 days per year of issued residential permit. You may apply online here or to make an appointment with one of our customer service reps to come in person
click here.
Overnight:
Limited parking available from 6:00pm to 8:00am at a discounted rate of $6/night in Garages “B”, “D”, or Midtown. If your car is parked after 6:00pm but remains in the garage beyond 8:00am the following morning, standard hourly rates apply. If you already have an active Resident parking permit, there is no need to purchase this type of parking in advance.
‍Monthly Senior:
Senior residents over the age of 62 may park their car in unreserved spaces of the garage 24/7 on a first come-first serve basis at a discounted senior rate.
Emergency/Event:
This option is announced on an “as needed” basis for residents who usually park on-street to temporarily park in designated municipal garages when emergency events are announced (snow, flooding, etc.). Limited parking is available on a first-come-first-serve basis, usually in 12- or 24-hour increments at certain garages as specified in the emergency announcement. If your car is parked beyond the discounted period specified in the announcement, standard hourly rates apply. If you already have a Resident or Temporary parking permit, there is no need to purchase this type of parking in advance; simply present your Resident or Temporary parking permit to the attendant with your ticket when existing at the gate and refer to the emergency announcement (or show a copy of the announcement).

Municipal Garage Projects:

In 2021, the Hoboken Parking Utility (HPU) installed new, state-of-the-art parking technology in the municipal garages. These improvements had included a new parking access system as well as a parking guidance system. The system’s improved technology streamlined the parking and payment experience for users with the following key improvements:

  • ‍License plate recognition (LPR)cameras: As each vehicle enters a garage, a license plate recognition (LPR) camera scans each vehicle's license plate, granting access to monthly permit parkers and registering entrance times for hourly parkers. Monthly parkers may add multiple license plates per account but only one vehicle per account will be allowed inside of the garage at a time. If a permit holder changes their license plate, they will be required to update the license plate number in their online account or contact the garage office at 201-653-7333.
  • ‍Online account portal for Monthly and "HHELPR" accounts: Monthly parking customers can now conveniently make monthly payments by credit or debit card, setup autopay, update account information, and more, with a new online account portal. Automatic payments begin on the 1st of your start month, as well as a $3.00 convenience fee, added to credit card and debit card payments made through the online portal.
  • ‍Parking guidance system: The new RedStorm Parking Guidance System notifies drivers of real-time parking spot availability through a digital sign displayed at the entrance of each garage. Parking availability information will also be accessible through the City's website.
  • ‍E-Validation system: A new online-based merchant validation system that streamlines the ability for merchants to purchase, activate, and track discount parking validations for their customers.
  • ‍Compatibility with popular parking reservations platforms: The new parking access system is compatible with popular parking reservation services, such as ParkWhiz and Spot Hero, which allows customers to reserve a parking space in a municipal garage before ever leaving their home.
  • ‍Touchless payments: With license plate recognition (LPR) cameras, daily parkers, HHELPR parkers, and e-validation beneficiaries will be able to simply insert a credit or debit card for payment in the exit lane.
